visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with vibrant green hair, red lipstick, and heavy eyelashes faces the camera, gesturing with her hands. She wears a dark grey t-shirt. Behind her is a light-colored wall with a golden vintage table clock. (2) A close-up shows a right eye with a brown eyeliner pen drawing a jagged, uneven line. Hand-drawn scribble overlays appear. (3) The woman returns to the full frame, holding a gold-capped brown eyeliner pen between her fingers. She points to her eyes and then shows the pen to the camera. (4) Close-up on the back of the woman's hand as she draws several translucent brown lines with the pen. She holds the pen at a slight angle. (5) On-screen view of the woman's right eye. She uses the translucent pen to draw a faint wing at the outer corner. She then uses a white tissue to wipe a small section away. (6) A different brown eyeliner pen with a sharper tip is shown. She draws a more solid, darker line on the back of her hand, overlapping the previous faint lines. (7) Close-up of the right eye again. She carefully traces over the faint translucent 'draft' line with the dark, solid eyeliner pen. (8) The woman demonstrates a very wet, 'faucet-like' eyeliner pen on her hand, which leaves a thick, watery blob. (9) She applies the watery eyeliner to her eye, then uses the drier translucent pen to pull the excess liquid into a sharp wing tip. (10) The woman poses with her hands framing her face, showcasing the final smooth eyeliner wings on both eyes.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long, wavy hair dyed a vivid teal/emerald green. She is wearing heavy glam makeup, including prominent false eyelashes, glittery pinkish eyeshadow, and glossy red lipstick. She is dressed in a dark grey crew-neck t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A plain, light blue or grey wall serves as the backdrop. A vintage-style ornate golden table clock with a circular white face and Roman numerals is positioned on the right side of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy Brazilian Phonk music begins with a heavy, distorted bass beat and rhythmic synth cowbell. A female voice speaks with high arousal and fast tempo. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX triggers as the speaker highlights a common problem, followed by a 'Whoosh' transition. (3) A digital 'Pop' sound occurs as a graphic appears. The music remains steady with a driving rhythm. (4) A 'Rewind' sound effect punctuates a transition to the demonstration. The speaker's tone is instructional yet enthusiastic. (5) Multiple 'Ding' and 'Ping' sound effects are used for emphasis as she shows the translucent pen. The vocal pitch stays relatively high. (6) A 'Meme' crying sound effect plays briefly when showing a bad eyeliner attempt. The BGM ducks slightly to favor the SFX. (7) A percussive 'Stinger' marks the transition to the final correction technique. The mix engineering is dense with transients from both the music and variety SFX overlays. (8) The phase ends with a final positive vocal flourish and a lingering bass beat from the music track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution A (Translucent Pen) -> Solution B (Handling watery pens) -> Result.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a makeup hack for beginners or individuals with shaky hands, specifically teaching them to use translucent pens as a 'draft' before applying solid eyeliner to ensure symmetry and precision.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently displays and uses specific eyeliner pens (K-Palette/1Day Tattoo and Set Ady) while demonstrating their functions, though the video is framed as a general tutorial.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-density 'variety show' editing style popular on social media, with frequent text overlays and sound effects to maintain viewer engagement during a technical makeup tutorial.
